notes.title: Update Notes (3/3/2022)
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Thank you so much for playing [i]Gnosia[/i].
Please find the list of fixes and adjustments included in the update below.

[list]
[*] Correction/adjustment of some localized text.
[*] The bug causing the screen to go black when gameplay starts has been fixed, with the "save setting" file properly regenerated.
*When resuming play, the name of the saved data will be temporarily rendered blank, but the game can be resumed normally.
[*] A separate vsync-enabled build is now available for players who prefer a version with no framerate limit.
Applicable branch: Closed Beta
Pass: 68387392gnocb
*There may be some issues with cursor movement in some environments with the vsync-enabled version of the build. If this occurs, please use the default build instead.
[/list]

We hope you continue to enjoy [i]Gnosia[/i].

notes.title: Provisional Fix for Gnosia Display Bug
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Regarding the bug preventing some character images from displaying properly on certain operating systems, we have uploaded a closed beta build for the version of the game currently available.

Branch: closed_beta
Password: 68387392gnocb

If you are unable to play the game due to display errors, please try switching to the "closed_beta" branch.

[b][How to change branches][/b]
1: Open Properties for Gnosia from your Steam Library.
2: Input the above-listed password into the beta text input field and press "Check Code". 
3: Select "closed_beta" from the Beta tab and close Properties.

This should solve the problem for most users who have encountered said errors. If you still experience bugs or other errors, please report them on the bug report thread. Thank you very much for your patience and cooperation.
